question: Who is appointed as Asian Cricket Council President in Feb, 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jay Shah**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Jay Shah** was appointed as the President of the Asian Cricket Council (ACC) in February 2021.
 
• Jay Shah is the **son of Amit Shah**, the Home Minister of India.
 
• He is also the **Secretary of the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI)**.
 
• His appointment as the ACC President is seen as a significant development in the cricketing world, given his influential position in Indian cricket.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Asian Cricket Council (ACC)**

 
 
• The ACC is a cricket organization which was established in 1983 to promote and develop the game of cricket in Asia.
 
• It is responsible for organizing cricket tournaments and events within Asia, including the Asia Cup.
 
• The ACC works in conjunction with the International Cricket Council (ICC) to enhance the standard of cricket in its member countries.
 
• The headquarters of the ACC is located in Colombo, Sri Lanka.
 
 
 
• **Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI)**
 
 
• The BCCI is the national governing body for cricket in India, founded in December 1928.
 
• It is responsible for the organization and governance of cricket activities in India, including domestic tournaments like the Ranji Trophy and the Indian Premier League (IPL).
 
• The BCCI is one of the richest and most powerful cricket boards in the world.
 
• It operates under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India.
 
 
 
• **Asia Cup**
 
 
• The Asia Cup is a men's One Day International (ODI) and Twenty20 International (T20I) cricket tournament.
 
• It was established in 1983 when the ACC was founded, with the aim of promoting goodwill and cricket within Asia.
 
• India has been the most successful team in the tournament, winning it multiple times.
 
• The tournament format alternates between ODI and T20I formats every two years, aligning with the respective ICC World Cup formats.
